accounting_framework: IFRS is the sole GAAP for commercial companies (Islamic banks apply AAOIFI FAS as the primary framework). English statements standard; Dhareeba tax portal filings.

default_tax_line.label: Taxes
default_tax_line.basis: Ownership-dependent - no safe default. CIT 10% flat (Law 24/2018) applies to the FOREIGN-owned share of profits; the Qatari/GCC-owned share is exempt (filing still required). Oil operations minimum 35%. Set tax_pct_ebt = 0.10 * foreign_ownership_share explicitly.

tax_recipes.pillar_two: 15% DMTT + IIR (Law 22/2024, implementing Cabinet Resolution 2/2026) for FYs from 1 Jan 2025, groups >= EUR 750m: use 0.15 if in scope.

vat_note: No VAT in force as of mid-2026 (GCC framework signed; e-invoicing draft law approved May 2026 as a likely precursor). Excise applies to limited goods.
fiscal_year_note: Calendar tax year default (first period may run 6-18 months); return due 4 months after year end via Dhareeba. QAR pegged at 3.64/USD.
depreciation_note: Tax depreciation = accounting depreciation capped at straight-line rates in the Executive Regulations (Council of Ministers Decision 39/2019, as amended Feb 2026): buildings 5%, furniture/office equipment 15%, vehicles 20%, computers 33.33%.
pillar_two_note: DMTT + IIR in force from FY2025 for large MNE groups.
disclosure: Tax modeled as an effective rate on earnings before tax reflecting the foreign-ownership share only (Qatari/GCC share exempt) - a simplification; not tax advice. Statements per IFRS. For MNE groups >= EUR 750m revenue, a 15% domestic minimum top-up tax + IIR applies from FY2025 regardless of ownership and is not reflected in the ownership-based rate.
